tasks.title: Stand up a minimal Chromium CDP session
definition_of_done: A small binary or test can launch headless Chromium and connect over CDP
Connection failures return structured errors instead of panicking

recommended.approach: Create a thin bootstrap path in the browser adapter that only establishes and tears down a session.

tasks.title: Capture URL/title/viewport from the active page
definition_of_done: Observation fields for URL, title, and viewport are populated from CDP
A test demonstrates these fields on a known page

recommended.approach: Implement the minimum snapshot contract first, then extend with element extraction.

tasks.title: Extract actionable accessibility nodes from page snapshot
definition_of_done: Snapshot returns actionable nodes with role and name metadata
At least one demo page yields 10 or more extracted nodes

recommended.approach: Use accessibility tree queries and filter to interactive roles for compactness.

tasks.title: Execute one click against an extracted element
definition_of_done: A selected element id from snapshot can be clicked through CDP
The click path reports success or a typed error

recommended.approach: Map element refs to backend node ids and implement one deterministic click flow.

tasks.title: Define Action enum with strict serde tagging
definition_of_done: Action JSON supports the required action types using explicit type tags
Unknown action types fail deserialization

recommended.approach: Use an internally tagged enum and avoid permissive fallback variants.

tasks.title: Add golden tests for valid action payloads
definition_of_done: One passing test exists per supported action type
Round-trip serialize and deserialize is stable for golden payloads

recommended.approach: Store canonical JSON examples and assert strict parsing behavior.

tasks.title: Add failure tests for malformed action payloads
definition_of_done: Malformed payloads fail with explicit parse or validation codes
Test cases include missing fields, wrong types, and unknown actions

recommended.approach: Cover the highest-frequency schema errors before wiring any LLM client.

tasks.title: Finalize crate module boundaries for agent, browser, llm, and telemetry
definition_of_done: Module tree compiles with explicit trait boundaries
No cross-module circular dependencies remain

recommended.approach: Define trait-first contracts and keep implementations behind module-private internals.

tasks.title: Define Observation type with required snapshot fields
definition_of_done: Observation includes URL, title, viewport, focused element, visible text, state hash, and elements
Observation serialization is covered by unit tests

recommended.approach: Keep Observation compact and stable, with explicit field semantics documented in code.

tasks.title: Define ElementRef type with stable id and interaction metadata
definition_of_done: ElementRef exposes id, role, name, value, bounding box, and flags
ElementRef fields serialize without lossy conversions

recommended.approach: Use explicit optional fields and avoid ad hoc map payloads.

tasks.title: Define StepResult contract for action outcomes
definition_of_done: StepResult includes ok status, structured error, and new state hash when available
All action executors return StepResult consistently

recommended.approach: Standardize success and failure envelopes before implementing advanced actions.

tasks.title: Implement browser lifecycle management with warm session reuse
definition_of_done: Agent can launch or connect to Chromium and reuse a session across steps
Browser shutdown is graceful and deterministic

recommended.approach: Separate session initialization from per-step action execution.

tasks.title: Implement navigate action with scheme restrictions
definition_of_done: Navigate supports http and https by default
Non-allowed schemes are rejected with structured validation errors

recommended.approach: Enforce URL policy in validator before browser calls.

tasks.title: Implement click action execution
definition_of_done: Click targets existing element ids from the latest observation
Detached or stale nodes return structured execution errors

recommended.approach: Resolve id-to-node mapping at execution time and fail loudly on mismatches.

tasks.title: Implement type action execution with optional submit
definition_of_done: Type writes text into text-capable controls
Submit branch triggers Enter or form submit behavior when requested

recommended.approach: Focus the element explicitly before input and keep submit logic deterministic.

tasks.title: Implement select action execution
definition_of_done: Select can choose an option by value or visible label
Invalid options return structured errors

recommended.approach: Resolve options from DOM at runtime and verify selected state post-action.

tasks.title: Implement bounded scroll action execution
definition_of_done: Scroll applies dx and dy with configured bounds
Out-of-range values are blocked by validation

recommended.approach: Validate bounds pre-execution and emit resulting scroll position where available.

tasks.title: Implement wait action with max duration guard
definition_of_done: Wait pauses execution for allowed durations only
Duration above configured max is rejected

recommended.approach: Treat wait as a first-class action so timing appears in logs and metrics.

tasks.title: Implement back navigation action
definition_of_done: Back triggers browser history navigation
No-history cases return a non-panicking structured error

recommended.approach: Use browser history APIs and confirm URL/title change in follow-up snapshot.

tasks.title: Implement extract action output contract
definition_of_done: Extract produces a structured payload in StepResult
Extraction outputs are schema-stable across runs

recommended.approach: Define extraction payload shape in core types and keep it deterministic.

tasks.title: Compute deterministic state hash from compact snapshot features
definition_of_done: Equivalent page states produce identical hashes
Navigation or meaningful DOM changes alter the hash

recommended.approach: Hash URL, title, and a stable subset of actionable elements in normalized order.

tasks.title: Stabilize element id generation across snapshots
definition_of_done: Repeated snapshots of static pages keep the same element ids
Id assignment remains deterministic after minor layout shifts

recommended.approach: Base ids on stable DOM/accessibility identity rather than snapshot index positions.

tasks.title: Implement compact visible_text extraction policy
definition_of_done: Observation includes meaningful visible text without full-page dumps
Extraction avoids sensitive form values by default

recommended.approach: Prioritize text from visible interactive and nearby content, with length caps.

tasks.title: Validate action id presence against current observation
definition_of_done: Actions requiring ids fail if the id does not exist in current elements
Error payload includes a machine-readable validation code

recommended.approach: Centralize id checks in validator so executors assume validated inputs.

tasks.title: Validate type text length constraints
definition_of_done: Type action text above max length is rejected
Boundary lengths are covered by unit tests

recommended.approach: Enforce text limits in validator with explicit error metadata.

tasks.title: Validate wait duration constraints
definition_of_done: Wait durations above maximum are rejected
Validation behavior is deterministic across platforms

recommended.approach: Normalize duration units and compare against one configured ceiling.

tasks.title: Validate scroll delta bounds
definition_of_done: Scroll dx and dy outside bounds are rejected
Bounds are configurable and tested

recommended.approach: Apply symmetric positive and negative limits in a shared numeric guard.

tasks.title: Validate navigate URL policy and allow_insecure override
definition_of_done: By default only http and https are accepted
Explicit allow_insecure config enables additional schemes

recommended.approach: Separate policy evaluation from parsing so errors clearly explain the rejection reason.

tasks.title: Implement OpenAI-compatible LLM client trait adapter
definition_of_done: LLM provider can request one action decision from observation context
Timeout and transport errors are surfaced as typed failures

recommended.approach: Hide provider-specific HTTP details behind a small client trait.

tasks.title: Enforce single-action JSON response contract from LLM
definition_of_done: Each LLM step yields exactly one parsed action
Non-JSON or multi-action outputs produce structured errors

recommended.approach: Constrain prompt format and parse with strict schema validation.

tasks.title: Implement failure streak counter for model escalation
definition_of_done: Consecutive step failures increment a dedicated counter
Counter threshold transitions model tier

recommended.approach: Track failures independently from no-progress to keep escalation reasons explicit.

tasks.title: Implement no-progress streak counter for model escalation
definition_of_done: Unchanged state hash increments no-progress counter
Configured threshold escalates model tier

recommended.approach: Use state hash comparisons at the loop boundary to keep behavior deterministic.

tasks.title: Reset router counters on confirmed progress
definition_of_done: Failure and no-progress counters reset when progress is detected
Unit tests cover reset behavior after mixed outcomes

recommended.approach: Define one progress predicate and reuse it in router and loop code paths.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic max-step agent loop
definition_of_done: Loop terminates on done action or max step limit
Termination state is explicit in the final result object

recommended.approach: Implement a linear state machine: snapshot, propose, validate, apply, record.

tasks.title: Persist per-step action history in memory
definition_of_done: History records action input, validation outcome, apply result, and timings
Final summary includes history-derived counts

recommended.approach: Use a single append-only step record type shared by logging and summaries.

tasks.title: Retain rolling window of recent observations for context
definition_of_done: Agent keeps the configured last N observations
Window is provided to LLM prompt builder in stable order

recommended.approach: Use a bounded deque and avoid retaining full raw DOM snapshots.

tasks.title: Implement final machine-readable run summary
definition_of_done: Summary includes terminal state, step count, errors, and output artifacts
Summary object is emitted even on failure paths

recommended.approach: Build final summary from history records rather than ad hoc state flags.

tasks.title: Implement mbus run CLI command with task and step flags
definition_of_done: CLI accepts task string and max step parameters
Invalid arguments return actionable CLI errors

recommended.approach: Define command options with clap and map directly to runtime config.

tasks.title: Load configuration from file and environment variables
definition_of_done: Config file values are read and merged with env overrides
Secret values are not printed in startup logs

recommended.approach: Apply a deterministic config precedence order and redact sensitive keys in logs.

tasks.title: Emit newline-delimited JSON logs per step
definition_of_done: Each step outputs one structured JSON line
Output includes action, outcome, and timing fields

recommended.approach: Define one step log schema and keep field names stable for downstream parsers.

tasks.title: Instrument snapshot and apply duration metrics
definition_of_done: snapshot_duration_ms and apply_duration_ms are emitted for each step
Metrics labels remain low-cardinality

recommended.approach: Emit metrics in one telemetry module and call from loop boundaries only.

tasks.title: Instrument LLM latency and failure counters
definition_of_done: llm_duration_ms and llm_failures_total metrics are emitted
Failures are tagged by structured error code

recommended.approach: Wrap client calls with timing and outcome capture in a single adapter layer.

tasks.title: Add tracing spans for snapshot, llm, validation, and apply
definition_of_done: Each major step stage is wrapped in a trace span
Trace metadata includes step index and chosen model tier

recommended.approach: Create a canonical span naming convention and apply it consistently in the loop.

tasks.title: Create local static pages for click/type/select coverage
definition_of_done: Harness includes deterministic pages for core action types
Pages are version-controlled and runnable in CI

recommended.approach: Keep pages intentionally simple with stable selectors and expected outcomes.

tasks.title: Add integration tests for click and type action success paths
definition_of_done: Integration tests verify click and type produce expected page state changes
Tests fail deterministically when action execution regresses

recommended.approach: Drive tests through public action APIs instead of private helper calls.

tasks.title: Add integration tests for select, scroll, and wait behavior
definition_of_done: Select, scroll, and wait actions have dedicated integration coverage
Assertions include both success and bounded constraint behavior

recommended.approach: Reuse shared harness fixtures and keep each test focused on one behavior.

tasks.title: Implement narrow JSON repair pass for malformed LLM outputs
definition_of_done: Common malformed outputs can be repaired into valid single actions
Unrepairable outputs preserve original error context

recommended.approach: Restrict repair to deterministic transformations to avoid changing action intent.

tasks.title: Track repair attempt and success metrics
definition_of_done: Telemetry exposes counts for repair attempts, successes, and failures
Per-run summary includes repair contribution

recommended.approach: Emit repair metrics at parser boundary and include fields in final run summary.

tasks.title: Add no-progress heuristic for repeated state hash
definition_of_done: Repeated identical state hash streak is tracked in loop state
Streak contributes to escalation and termination decisions

recommended.approach: Implement hash streak as an explicit loop state variable with test coverage.

tasks.title: Add low-actionability heuristic for sparse interactive pages
definition_of_done: Observation with too few actionable nodes triggers heuristic signal
Heuristic signal is logged and influences escalation policy

recommended.approach: Compute actionability score from element count and role distribution.

tasks.title: Write extract action outputs to JSON artifact
definition_of_done: Extracted payloads are persisted to a configurable file path
Output schema includes task metadata and timestamps

recommended.approach: Keep extraction artifact schema versioned and append-safe for repeated runs.

tasks.title: Document install and quickstart workflow
definition_of_done: Docs cover prerequisites, install, and first successful run
Commands are validated against current CLI behavior

recommended.approach: Add a concise quickstart path first, then extend with optional configuration detail.

tasks.title: Document operations runbook and troubleshooting
definition_of_done: Docs include common error modes and recovery steps
Runbook includes verification and rollback instructions

recommended.approach: Map troubleshooting sections directly to structured error codes and log fields.

tasks.title: Add benchmark LLM mode selection for scripted and openai
definition_of_done: mbus bench accepts llm-mode flag or config with scripted and openai values
No hardcoded scripted override remains in benchmark execution

recommended.approach: Thread llm-mode from CLI/config into benchmark runtime selection logic.

tasks.title: Preserve benchmark gate checks across both benchmark modes
definition_of_done: required_passes and step limits are enforced for scripted and openai
Gate outcome is included in benchmark report artifacts

recommended.approach: Share one gate evaluation function across all benchmark modes.

tasks.title: Collect per-task token usage from openai benchmark runs
definition_of_done: Per-task prompt, completion, and total token counts are captured
Missing usage data is handled with explicit null or error fields

recommended.approach: Capture provider usage metadata at LLM call boundaries and aggregate by task.

tasks.title: Aggregate benchmark token totals and estimated USD cost
definition_of_done: Report includes aggregate prompt, completion, total tokens, and estimated cost
Cost computation uses configurable per-1M input/output pricing

recommended.approach: Implement a pure aggregation module with unit-tested cost math.

tasks.title: Extend benchmark report artifact schema with mode and economics
definition_of_done: Report includes llm mode, model names, gate result, duration, token totals, and cost totals
Report fields are stable and versioned for reproducibility

recommended.approach: Evolve report schema with backward-compatible additions and explicit version metadata.

tasks.title: Add benchmark tests for mode parsing and token-cost aggregation
definition_of_done: Unit tests cover llm-mode parsing and pricing math edge cases
Integration coverage exists for scripted mode and mocked openai usage path

recommended.approach: Test pure config and aggregation modules independently from live provider calls.

tasks.title: Run autonomous openai benchmark on 10-task harness and capture artifact
definition_of_done: A reproducible openai benchmark run artifact is checked in or archived
Artifact confirms gate result, duration, token totals, and cost totals

recommended.approach: Execute bench with pinned config and store report with timestamp and model identifiers.
